name: Ayurveda & wellness
text: Kerala is famous for Ayurveda, India's traditional system of medicine. Options range from a one-hour massage to 14–21 day treatment programmes with a doctor. Yoga and Kalaripayattu (Kerala's martial art) are often offered alongside.
tips: Choose a centre classified by the Department of Tourism (Green Leaf or Olive Leaf)
The monsoon (Jun–Aug) is the traditional season
